tests.name: Onboarding: annual trial vs weekly first
tests.action: Keep Weekly first: it clearly wins on paid conversion and 60-day revenue per user. Watch refunds, since they are 11.5% of payers vs 9.6%.

tests.name: Settings: upgrade vs lifetime anchor
tests.action: Do not ship Settings - Upgrade as the winner. Keep Lifetime anchor or re-run only with a new hypothesis, since it converts higher and revenue is not proven worse.

tests.name: Main: 3 plans vs lifetime anchor (NA)
tests.action: Read this on a longer window before locking the decision, because the Lifetime anchor lead shrinks from $9.30 at day 7 to $3.11 by day 110. Watch the mix closely, since 44.3% of Lifetime anchor revenue is one-time lifetime purchases.
